name: China New City Commercial Development Limited
summary: China New City Commercial Development Limited, founded in 1997 and headquartered in Hangzhou, is an investment holding company owned by Ideal World Investments Limited. It develops, rents and operates commercial properties and hotels in mainland China and abroad. Its main work is building integrated commercial complexes in the Yangtze River Delta's secondary cities, leasing offices and malls, and running four hotels including the Holiday Inn Hangzhou Xiaoshan.
